title:
Comment of Sarah Husted in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/12/2026

documents.name: 151532.txt
documents.text:
Sarah Husted, Wasilla, AK.
To whom it may concern,
I am an Alaskan who is very much against this proposed data center in the Cook Inlet. There is no benefit to Alaskans for this hyperscale underwater data center to be built. This will be devastating for the whole state when it comes to our salmon fishing, the endangered beluga whales that frequent the Cook Inlet, and our waters. This will bring pollution, EMF that will harm aquatic wildlife, and other unforeseen ecological issues. Please do not threaten our aquatic landscape with a data center.
Thank you for your consideration.
